summary: Full e2e testing of Alameda 500 quiz MVP (backend + frontend). Backend: 9/9 pytest API tests passed (health, leads CRUD, validations, summary). Frontend: full QUENTE flow, FRIO flow and lead-form validations all passed via Playwright on the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. WhatsApp CTA points to wa.me/5527996610579 with classification embedded. Phone mask BR works. 6 quiz questions show correct progress (17%->100%). Gallery has 6 items. Restart returns to intro. No bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('shutdown'); migrate to lifespan handlers (non-blocking, just future-proof).
POST /api/leads returns 200; consider returning 201 Created for REST correctness.
GET /api/leads has no pagination cursor — fine for MVP; consider skip/limit if leads grow.
No rate limiting on /api/leads — public endpoint can be spammed; add simple throttle/captcha before launch.

Frontend stores classification client-side and sends it to backend; backend trusts it without re-computing from answers. Recommend recomputing classification server-side from answers + weights to avoid tampering.
Phone is stored as user-typed (with mask). For analytics/dedupe, consider normalising to E.164 or digits-only before persistence.
test_credentials: N/A - no auth in this app
seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_-prefixed leads via API + UI flows for verification (quente, morno, frio).
